name: Bugey
summary: The Bugey programme comprised several historical reactor-antineutrino measurements. Bugey-3 compared spectra at three short baselines, while Bugey-4 provided a precise integral inverse-beta-decay yield frequently used as a reference by later reactor experiments.
detection_principle: Hydrogen-rich targets detect inverse beta decay. Bugey-3 used segmented lithium-loaded scintillator and the coincidence of positron energy with neutron capture; Bugey-4 used an integral neutron-detection approach. These are distinct configurations within one historical site programme.

results.summary: No oscillatory spectral distortion was established; the relative spectra constrained electron-antineutrino disappearance.
